notes.title: Bugfix & new map
notes.content:
- Crash during an AI move if air units were blocked in certain ways (AngrySwan)
- added Fall Weiss North in a beta state. Some texts are missing but it should be playable quite good otherwise

notes.title: Campaign update
notes.content:
The Eastern Front:

- new missions were added that can be played depending on the paths (victories/defeats) you take:
	- Bialystok
	- Chimki
	- Maikop
	- Kalinin
	- Voronezh
	- Rostov 1942
	- Stalingrad

This is a fanmade campaign done by Zigmunds Steins. Discuss it with him in our forum:

https://forum.phobetor.de/board.php?boardid=24

notes.title: Update December 2021
notes.content:
Added:

- Blank map (no units) of the Netherlands (summer) for 1940 in editor\Docs\Sinlge Maps\
- Art of War: new map <Dubno Brody> (four maps in total now)
- Ground units can now embark into sea transports in ports and disembark on coast and in ports
- Sea transports fully implemented for Germany and Russia
- Editor: new option to choose units to be embarked in sea transport in Script and Map Editors
- Reworked harbour graphics with four variants
- New settlement ornaments for coastal hexes

Fixed:

Art of War:

- Campaign results were neither displayed and nor stored (Medals)
- Belgrade: German text reworked/fixed

notes.title: Hotfix notes 2/2021
notes.content:
Several small issues have surfaced since the release which were adressed:

Fixed:

- Tutorial crashed after first map (fedsmokerps hellride)
- German names for two single maps were missing ( Taifun über Moskau and Weg nach Demyansk) (AngrySwan)
- Steam feature: Several achievements were implemented wrong and did not trigger

Arkhangelsk-Astrakhan:

- Melitopol: Missing town names in German
- Moscow: Text message on Soviet Siberian troops had English title in German translation.(AngrySwan)

- Soviet Dawn: 

- Bagration: 9.TankCorps reinforcement could be blocked if a unit was placed on Gomel

Added:

- Blank map of northern Poland/eastern Germany (summer) for 1939 in editor\Docs\Sinlge Maps\
